statement: SDL3 Triton HIDAPI uses per-driver SDL_JOYSTICK_HIDAPI_STEAM then global SDL_JOYSTICK_HIDAPI fallback; direct 1302 selection is VID/PID with no interface-number filter. Active SDL joystick sends 0x87 setting9=0 about every 3s, and explicit sensor enable/disable sends key48; close does not restore. SDL Linux evdev backend also skips device when higher-priority SDL HIDAPI owns VID/PID; Linux hid-steam separately unregisters native synthetic evdev on raw open. Neither guarantees all potential Steam virtual/native duplicates avoided.
